per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Parts search shall return results so that the perceived search operation completes within 15 seconds for interactive users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Facility lookup (preferred repair facilities by vehicle location) shall return results within 10 seconds, with an ideal target of 8 seconds for interactive phone calls.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Audit reports for recycled parts shall generate and return results within 10 seconds so the user can remain in the active estimate without switching tasks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: System availability shall be at least approximately 98% during business hours (i.e., 'up pretty much all the time we're working').
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: System shall support concurrent usage of up to approximately 1,500 simultaneous users without unacceptable degradation of interactive performance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Save operations for actions like ratings or notes shall provide a visible confirmation and complete within 5 seconds to avoid duplicate submissions and user confusion.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The preferred repair facility ratings shall be saved within 5 seconds. The save shall occur within 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Save confirmation must appear within 5 seconds; if no confirmation is shown within 5 seconds the user will likely re-submit.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The preferred repair facility ratings shall be saved within 5 seconds. The save shall occur within 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall enforce strict data partitioning so that insurer-specific claims are accessible only to authorized users of that insurer and not visible to other companies.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Role-based access control must be implemented so program admins have cross-company access for audits/reports, while adjusters/estimators see only their company's claims and shop coordinators have limited assignment/contact views.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: In field (spotty network) conditions the application shall handle flaky connectivity gracefully by allowing viewing of recently fetched results and maintaining session continuity where possible (e.g., caching and not breaking the session).
The system shall warn users before session timeouts with a visible countdown and provide a 'stay signed in' option; it shall also autosave drafts of in‑progress work to prevent data loss on timeout.
When aggregated cross-company features (e.g., shop ratings) are shared, they shall be anonymized or aggregated so individual company claims or identifying details cannot be traced back.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Help content (inline tips or a help button) shall be available in approximately 90% of screens to support discoverability and reduce support calls.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Training/onboarding shall enable the majority (~95%) of adjusters and estimators to be comfortable using the system after two days of hands-on, onsite training, measured by a skills check or survey.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: User interface shall be uncluttered and minimize visible buttons/elements to reduce cognitive load and user mistakes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'
